advances:
The full inherited opposite semialgebraic system remains nonempty after
the exhaustive six-way global slope-cap disjunction of
`c5b7a9a9bad7377d` is imposed.  A strict rational relative-interior
point survives in the positive-offset case (A+).  Thus this
parameterized global cap family does not close the opposite branch.
The next untested global \(A_2\) condition is the opposite-end
three-chord completion problem in
\((T,R)=(-q_j,-q_\ell)=(S-U+V,-V)\): among convex polygons with the
three prescribed full cutting-line chords and prescribed
\(|Q_N|=g\), determine the exact possible range of the terminal cap
\(|Q_{k\ell}|=s\).  The inherited two-section inequality (19f) and
the endpoint-cap rows do not solve this simultaneous three-chord
completion problem.

proof:
Accepted fact `c5b7a9a9bad7377d` proves that the new global
constraint is the finite exhaustive union of (A+), (A0), (B+),
(B0), (C+), and (C0).  The equivalences
\(u=0\Longleftrightarrow v=0\) and
\(\theta=0\Longleftrightarrow w_0=0\) put every zero-offset stratum
in exactly one of those alternatives, equality
\(\theta=w_0>0\) belongs to (A), and the positive-part formulas are
literal polynomial disjunctions.  It therefore suffices for
nonemptiness to give one strict point in one branch.  We now audit
every inherited and new condition at the displayed point.

First, all twelve cell areas, all six chord lengths, \(\Delta\), and
\(\delta\) are positive.  The scalar identities are exact:
\[
 c-g_0-y=0,\qquad
 a+e+x-d-s-w=0,
\]
\[
 2b-5(g_0+y+d+s+w)-7(g+z)=0.
\]
The total areas and common crossing are
\[
 M=\frac{2829009}{20000},\qquad
 m=\frac{409}{20},\qquad
 \kappa=\frac{407}{20},\qquad
 t=\frac{405001}{10000}.
\]
The three cap triples, their exact crossing sums, and their left-tail
slacks are
\[
\begin{array}{c|ccc|c|c}
i&u_i&v_i&C_i&u_i+v_i+C_i&C_i+m-t\\ \hline
j&1/10000&203/10&101/5&t&1499/10000\\
k&1/10000&81/4&81/4&t&1999/10000\\
\ell&2001/10000&403/20&403/20&t&999/10000.
\end{array}
\]
The proper-cap slacks
\((M-u_i,m-v_i,\kappa-C_i)\) are, respectively,
\[
 \left(\frac{2829007}{20000},\frac3{20},\frac3{20}\right),
\]
\[
 \left(\frac{2829007}{20000},\frac15,\frac1{10}\right),
\qquad
 \left(\frac{2825007}{20000},\frac3{10},\frac15\right).
\]
Moreover
\[
 M-t=\frac{2019007}{20000}>0,\qquad
 M-m=\frac{2420009}{20000}>0,\qquad t>0.
\]
This verifies the crossings, proper caps, both tails, finite-interior
conditions, \(M\ge m\), and \(W=0\).

For the trace lower bounds,
\[
 a(a+b)=d(d+b)=\frac{2825007}{200000000}<\frac14,
\]
\[
 (c+d)(b+c+d)
 =\frac{5660843007}{200000000}<36.
\]
Hence \(\eta_j,\eta_k<1/2\) and \(\eta_\ell<6\).  Since
\(2\Delta/\delta=1/50\), the three lower-bound slacks are strictly
larger than
\[
 \frac9{100},\qquad \frac9{100},\qquad \frac2{25}.
\]
The strict trace-gap slacks
\[
 K_2-J=\frac1{10},\qquad
 J_2-K=\frac3{25},\qquad
 H_2-H=\frac1{20}
\]
select the strict side of every trace disjunction.  The \(A_2\)
trace-product slack is
\[
 2\Delta g_0-J_2H_2=\frac{29}{200}>0.
\]
Also \((17/12)^2>2\), so \(3-2\sqrt2>1/6\), and consequently
\[
 2\Delta c(3-2\sqrt2)-KH
 >\frac1{15}-\frac1{50}
 =\frac7{150}>0.
\]

The \(A_0\) boxes and literal strata are strict:
\[
 \alpha,\beta,\gamma,\tau,\chi>0,\qquad
 \delta-\alpha-J=\frac{501}{10},\qquad
 \delta-\beta-H=\frac1{20000}.
\]
For (10a)-(12b) of `fa0e57b225178b3b`, the exact right-minus-left
slacks are
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{row}&\text{slack}\\ \hline
10a&98249901/20000000\\
10b&952099/20000000\\
11a&52508101/200000\\
11b&75959/200000\\
11c&669701/2500\\
12a&3991996004001/40000000000\\
12b&2441/40000000000.
\end{array}
\]
The two positive-part arguments in (12a)-(12b) are
\[
 \alpha H-\beta J=-\frac{3999}{200000}<0,\qquad
 \gamma H-\tau K=\frac{39}{200000}>0,
\]
so the point is in the relative interior of the stated branches.

For every endpoint-cap row, write
\[
 \Theta_\nu=2\Delta D_\nu r_\nu-L_\nu^2\sigma_\nu,
\qquad
 \mathcal E_\nu
 =D_\nu\sigma_\nu(r_\nu+L_\nu)^2
  -C_\nu(\Theta_\nu)_+.
\]
The six \(A_0\) rows have
\[
\begin{array}{c|cc}
\nu&\Theta_\nu&\mathcal E_\nu\\ \hline
A0\text{-}1&-1976079/2000000&
497005746999/20000000000\\
A0\text{-}2&3794793999/100000000&
1885790886793048299/20000000000000\\
A0\text{-}3&-3/10000000&
10201/200000000000000\\
A0\text{-}4&2817007/200000000&
22686658881007/(8\cdot10^{15})\\
A0\text{-}5&-98999/100000&
6300163001/250000000\\
A0\text{-}6&-2404999/5000000&
5020125310701/100000000000.
\end{array}
\]
No \(\Theta_\nu\) vanishes and every
\(\mathcal E_\nu\) is positive.

The \(A_2\) boxes and literal strata are also strict:
\[
 u,v,w_0,\theta,\psi>0,\qquad
 u+H_2=\frac{11}{20}<S,\qquad
 w_0+K_2=\frac{251}{5}<S.
\]
For (19a)-(19f) of `fa0e57b225178b3b`, counting the two sides of
(19a) separately, the exact slacks are
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{row}&\text{slack}\\ \hline
19a\text{, left}&39/5050\\
19a\text{, right}&373/25260\\
19b&1/250\\
19c&179/25\\
19d&83/10\\
19e&2193/500000\\
19f&2063493/5000.
\end{array}
\]
Here the positive-part arguments are
\[
 vH_2-uJ_2=\frac9{1000}>0,\qquad
 w_0H_2-\theta K_2=-\frac{779}{100}<0.
\]
Thus both completion inequalities lie strictly inside their selected
branches.

The six \(A_2\) endpoint-cap rows have
\[
\begin{array}{c|cc}
\nu&\Theta_\nu&\mathcal E_\nu\\ \hline
A2\text{-}1&2637/25000&1419/250000\\
A2\text{-}2&9657/800&49719/80000\\
A2\text{-}3&5471/500&381298687/10000\\
A2\text{-}4&11549/200&3079769/20\\
A2\text{-}5&480161/12500&13514391407/125000\\
A2\text{-}6&1431/125&51578469/1250.
\end{array}
\]
Again every \(\Theta_\nu\) and every \(\mathcal E_\nu\) is strictly
positive.

The three cyclic four-section slacks of
`cc1a8f11f870255e` are
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
\mathcal H_{j\ell}&747501/100000\\
\mathcal H_{k\ell}&75739/1000000\\
\mathcal H_{jk}&45459/5000.
\end{array}
\]
The six stronger coordinatewise-separator slacks, in the order
\[
\theta-(\beta+H),\quad w_0-(\alpha+J),\quad
u-(\tau+H),\quad v-(\gamma+K),
\]
\[
S+v-(\delta+\gamma+K),\quad
\psi-(\delta-\alpha),
\]
are
\[
 \frac{29001}{20000},\quad \frac1{10},\quad
 \frac{1999}{20000},\quad \frac{199}{1000},\quad
 \frac{2199}{1000},\quad \frac85.
\]

It remains to check the new global inequality.  In the notation of
`c5b7a9a9bad7377d`, where \(J=J_2\) and \(H=H_2\),
\[
 L=u+H_2=\frac{11}{20},\qquad
 q=v+J_2=\frac{13}{25},
\]
\[
 P=vH_2-uJ_2=\frac9{1000},\qquad
 X=2\Delta g_0-uJ_2-vH_2-J_2H_2=\frac1{250}>0.
\]
Moreover
\[
 \theta-w_0=\frac{1029}{20}>0,\qquad w_0>0,\qquad u>0,
\]
so this is strictly the (A+) branch.  Its positive-part argument is
\[
 LP+uX=\frac{123}{20000}>0.
\]
The left side, right side, and strict slack in (A+) are
\[
 2\Delta e(LP+uX)=\frac{123}{50000},
\]
\[
 J_2^2uL^2=\frac{43923}{10000000},
\qquad
 \frac{43923}{10000000}-\frac{123}{50000}
 =\frac{19323}{10000000}>0.
\]

Every nonidentity inherited inequality is therefore strict, every
positive-part or endpoint-cap branch has a nonzero defining sign,
and the (A+) endpoint-order inequalities are strict.  The point is a
rational relative-interior point of the selected finite
semialgebraic branch.  This proves
\(\mathcal S_{\rm slope}\ne\varnothing\).

The remaining global issue is not another scalar or two-section
audit.  In the coordinates
\[
 T=-q_j=S-U+V,\qquad R=-q_\ell=-V,
\]
\(Q_N\) lies in \(T,R>0\), while \(Q_{k\ell}\) is the terminal
\(T<0,R>0\) cap.  The next exact test is therefore the extremal
completion problem over single convex polygons having the prescribed
full \(T=0\), \(R=0\), and \(q_k=0\) chords and prescribed
\(Q_N\)-area \(g\): determine the exact allowable values of the
\(Q_{k\ell}\)-area \(s\).  No such simultaneous condition occurs in
the inherited endpoint-cap, separator, or cyclic four-section lists,
so it is the next precise polygon-completion checkpoint.

All fractions above were reduced by exact rational arithmetic using
Python's `fractions.Fraction`.  The computation only performed direct
substitution and rational reduction of the displayed slacks.  It did
not search the region and supplies no numerical infeasibility or CAD
claim.  Branch exhaustiveness and the global slope-cap implication
come from the proofs in the cited accepted facts.
